newsitem.title: USA: Liposome's Abelcet sales up 18-20 pct seq.
newsitem.headline: Liposome's Abelcet sales up 18-20 pct seq.

text.p: Liposome Co president Charles Baker said sales of the company's Abelcet drug for fungal infections are growing 18 to 20 percent quarter to quarter.
Abelcet is a liposome-based fomulation of the drug amphotericin-B and is being targeted to patients who fail that conventional therapy and in new untapped markets overseas.
He also estimated that, despite the strong showing to date, 85 percent of the potential Abelcet market remains unpenetrated.

"While we do not expect all of that market will be penetrated, clearly there remains substantial opportunity for conversion to Abelcet from (conventional) amphotericin B," said Baker, who spoke at the Hambrecht and Quist Healthcare Conference here.
